t: A weatherproof battery camera that spots animals, people, and objects on its own.
steps: Buy the NeoEyes NE301 from the CamThink store and pick a lens and connection type.
Add four AA batteries or plug in a USB-C cable.
Join the Wi-Fi hotspot the camera creates with your phone or laptop.
Open the built-in web page in your browser.
Connect the camera to your home Wi-Fi from the settings page.
Try the live preview and load one of the ready-made detection models.
Set a wake-up trigger, such as a timer, and test it outdoors.
Explore the CamThink quick-start wiki for training your own model.
